title: Bounded AC1024 R24 TABLESTYLE typed DXF readback

sourceBasis.readbackInput: The existing in-memory R24 model used by the ASCII/Binary output selector; no DWG or DXF fixture was added.
sourceBasis.scope: The reader projects only the four emitted Table/title/header/data styles in the witnessed order and validates them against the existing CellStyleMap style constraints. Other marker layouts remain raw-only.

implementation.summary: Parse the bounded R24 TABLEFORMAT, CONTENTFORMAT, CELLMARGIN, GRIDFORMAT and CELLSTYLE marker sequence into DRW_TableStyle typed nested styles. Retain raw capture as before and fail closed to raw-only typed publication for incomplete, reordered, unsupported-version or mismatched style profiles.
implementation.compatibility: No virtual interface changed. DRW_TableStyle gains private parse state; binary ABI qualification remains open under P8.
implementation.fixturePolicy: Uses generated in-memory source models and temporary ASCII/Binary outputs. No external or new fixture files were committed.

proof.readback: Fresh ASCII and Binary import yields exactly one typed and one raw TABLESTYLE. The selector checks the table-style link, default Table identity, all three custom style identities, content datatype/alignment/text height and style handle, zero versus six-border shapes, edge/type/lineweight/spacing values, and the existing raw marker/order and output-handle checks.

limits: This proves local typed readback for the emitted AC1024 R24 profile; it does not independently establish Autodesk semantics, native TABLE rendering, or LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD or other consumer acceptance.
Other TABLESTYLE marker ordering or additional/custom cell-style layouts remain raw-only until separately source-backed and implemented.
The P5 umbrella remains OPEN for other rendering, dynamic-block, FIELD, TABLECONTENT and AC1018 TABLE work.
